title: Wet Dreams
summary: A wet dream (nocturnal emission) is an orgasm or ejaculation during sleep. It is a normal part of puberty and adulthood, not a disease or weakness.
key_points: Common myths in South Asia link wet dreams to 'loss of strength' — this isn't true.
They can happen with or without sexual dreams and tend to become less frequent with age.
answer_guidance: Users may carry shame or myths ('dhat'); reassure with facts and without judgement.
